name: Fulgurite Electro-Priest

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: Ossifa may use Ruin Actions, and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Omnissiah's Tears
bonuses.text: An Electro-Priest sees without eyes, sensing only the Motive Force that powers all life. This Threat cannot be Blinded.

abilities.name: Voltagheist Burst
abilities.text: Inflict d3 Mortal Wounds on everyone within 5 metres that does not have this ability.

abilities.name: Siphoned Vigour
abilities.text: Whenever this Threat inflicts one or more Wounds, it regains Shock equal to the number of Wounds it inflicted. Alternatively, it may remove any Conditions it is currently suffering from.

determination: Fanatical Devotion: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 4d6. This threat can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds.
note: No Tier row printed; class proposed (Champion, Ossifa's block). Beside homebrew hat-fulgurite-electro-priest (different). Resilience printed "*7" and "AR *2" with an asterisk and no footnote.
